_doc: Phase 8d — last round of trend-class diversification. Two trend strategies that AREN'T pure breakout-by-channel — used to test whether Phase 8a's edge is in the Donchian channel logic specifically or in 'any trend filter + ATR stop'.

_hypothesis.adx_trend_4h: ADX Trend Rider only enters when ADX > 25 — a regime filter Donchian lacks. Theory: skipping flat/choppy markets (ADX < 25) is where Donchian loses money. If ADX-gated trend matches or beats Donchian, the regime filter IS the edge, not the entry signal.
_hypothesis.supertrend_4h: ATR-based trend-following with dynamic support/resistance. Same indicator family as Donchian (trend-following) but volatility-adjusted entry/exit lines instead of fixed lookback channels. Tests robustness across implementation variants of the same trend idea.
_hypothesis.expected_outcome: If both underperform Phase 8a OOS, we've empirically validated that Phase 8a is the optimal single-strategy choice for BTC and we stop iterating. If one beats 8a, we have a new candidate.
